title: Disposition capability 'mission-orchestrator' for mission-e39d21fa closure
notApplicableReason: The mission-orchestrator role was performed inline by the lead session throughout mission-e39d21fa (impact assessment, execution-graph selection, delegating bounded reviewer/implementer tasks, resolving conflicts, closing the completion gate) rather than as a separately dispatched capability with its own task record -- there is exactly one orchestrator per mission by design, and it IS the session doing this closure.
